name: Electronic fuse IC
summary: An integrated semiconductor power-path device providing the selected current-limiting and protection functions.
description: An integrated semiconductor power-path device providing the selected current-limiting and protection functions.

On a schematic, identify the input/output power terminals, enable and fault/configuration pins and trace the protected electronic supply and status/control circuit. Keep the component tag and signal/reference names consistent across the control drawing, terminal schedule and device documentation.
An eFuse is an electronic protection circuit; it is not the same component as a replaceable fuse or an MCB.

The preview is an independently drawn educational functional reference. Add the selected component’s actual power pins, terminal numbers, timing or analogue reference details when producing a construction drawing.
